Die Lage darüber im Wickel magnetisiert: The next layer on the reel picks up some magnetization: a very quiet echo one revolution later (about 1.6 s at 15 ips). Midrange only, audible only in quiet passages. Default: off.
Ein Hauch des anderen Kanals, kapazitiv: A trace of the other channel, capacitive – rising toward the highs. Measured at 10 kHz. Real gear sits between −60 and −80 dB.
Einmessung des Bias als „Überbias bei 10: Bias calibration as “overbias at 10 kHz”. Less: more distortion, more open highs · more: cleaner, duller. The Bias knob on the front moves around this point.
Einpegeln: wie im Studio wird jeder Tite: Gain staging: just like in the studio, every track is brought to 0 VU (−18 LUFS) before the units and exactly back afterwards – drive works the same on any music, loudness stays put. Turn it off per unit under the hood.
Exemplar {n} von 4 – jedes klingt minima: Unit {n} of 4 – each sounds slightly different (component tolerances, from HQ up). Click: another unit
Gemeinsam: beide Kanäle hängen an einem: Shared: both channels hang off one power supply – loud bass on the left makes the voltage sag slightly on the right too (under 0.3 dB). Separate: each channel on its own.

Innenleben: Einmessung, Bauteile, Netzte: Under the hood: calibration, components, power supply, unit – like behind the front panel
Kathodenfolger hinter der Röhre: folgt f: Cathode follower after the tube: follows almost 1:1 but can barely source grid current – when the plate swings toward the supply, it rounds off. Punchier, grittier (as in many guitar amps).
Kinonorm: Filme und Mehrkanal-Musik misc: Cinema standard: movies and multichannel music mix the LFE channel 10 dB down; the sub has to bring it back up.
Klingt besser: Hysterese, Bauteilstreuun: Sounds better: hysteresis, component tolerances, drift, more oversampling.
Klingt gut, kaum Rechenlast – auf jedem: Sounds good, barely any load – on any device.
Kopfbuckel (Lage, Höhe, Güte), Höhen der: Head bump (frequency, height, Q), playback highs and the machine's wow and flutter. A80: strong bump, studio transport · ATR-102: wide head, very steady transport · B77: small machine, bump sits higher, a bit more wow · Neutral: same as HQ.
Koppelkondensator vor dem Gitter (100 nF: Coupling capacitor ahead of the grid (100 nF · 330 nF · 1 µF): when a transient drives the grid into conduction, it charges up and the stage needs a moment to return to its operating point (“blocking”). Long = more breathing after peaks.
Laute Höhen löschen sich beim Aufnehmen: Loud highs partly erase themselves while recording – at the head gap the bias acts like a tiny erase head. Takes some sheen out of cymbals and sibilants at high levels.
Leuchtet, wenn der Sub kurz zurückgenomm: Lights up when the sub is briefly turned down so the sum of bass and LFE doesn't clip.
Mehr Windungen auf der Ausgangsseite heb: More turns on the output side raise the level (compensated) – the winding capacitance pulls the core's top-end character lower, and the core is pushed a little harder.
Mit ULTRA markierte Teile wirken nur in: Parts marked ULTRA only take effect in Ultra – you can set them anyway.
Mit den Jahren lässt die Emission nach:: Over the years emission drops: less current, a bit less gain, earlier and softer saturation. Stays with your unit.
Netzbrumm mit Gleichrichter-Oberwelle, s: Mains hum with rectifier harmonic, very quiet (around −85 dBFS), a bit more under load. Default: off.
Nur bei NAB: der Tiefbass wird bei der A: NAB only: low bass is boosted on record and taken back exactly on playback – the tape saturates earlier in the bass while the response stays flat.
Nur wenn der Sub selbst schon +10 dB auf: Only if the sub already adds +10 dB on its LFE input.
Sync: der Aufnahmekopf liest mit (wie be: Sync: the record head does the playback (as for overdubs) – wider gap, the top highs roll off earlier.
Ultra bildet die Schaltung Bauteil für B: Ultra models the circuit part by part – with everything you can set under the hood. That takes considerably more processing power than HQ.
Vier Geräte derselben Serie – jedes mit: Four units from the same production run – each with its own component tolerances (operating point, drive, highs per channel). Your unit stays with your device. Works from HQ up.
Was hinter dem Übertrager hängt. 600 Ω:: What's connected after the transformer. 600 Ω: old studio standard – more current, a bit more bass distortion, damped highs · 10 kΩ: typical today, neutral · open (high impedance): the leakage resonance stays, a bit more sheen up top.
Widerstand: die übliche Stufe. Drossel:: Resistor: the usual stage. Choke: same idle point, much steeper load line – more swing, noticeably less distortion. Transformer: in between.
Wie heiß das Band eingemessen ist (Fluss: How hot the tape is calibrated (flux at 0 VU). 185 = NAB reference, 250 = studio standard, 320/355 = “+6” calibration for modern tape: more saturation, less noise, less headroom.
Wie im Studio: jeder Titel wird vor dem: Just like in the studio: every track is brought to 0 VU (−18 LUFS) before the unit and exactly back afterwards – loud masters don't hit the unit harder than quiet ones, and loudness stays the same.
Wie stark sich der Kern an das Vorherige: How strongly the core remembers what came before (width of the hysteresis loop). More: more low-level distortion after loud passages, the bass “sticks” a little.
Wirbelströme im Blech: Kernverluste, die: Eddy currents in the laminations: core losses that rise with frequency – they damp the top-end resonance with an open load and take a hair off the top octave.
kaum Hysterese, sehr offen – moderne Ban: barely any hysteresis, very open – modern tape-wound cores
sehr sauber bis zum Knie, dann recht plö: very clean up to the knee, then fairly sudden – mic transformers
Übertrager am Ausgang: Kern sättigt sanf: Transformer at the output: the core saturates gently in the low bass, bass corner around 14 Hz, a hair less top octave.
